columns.name: fullname
columns.description: Full name of the driver. Concatenate the first name and last name with a space separating them.

columns.name: num_winnings
columns.description: The number of races where the driver finished first; replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: year_and_race_of_fastest_lap
columns.description: Concatenate the year and the name of the race, separated by a space, in which the driver had his fastest lap, with ties broken by the ascending of the year first, then descending order of the name of the race

columns.name: points_recorded_for_first_race
columns.description: The points recorded for the driver's first race event, with ties broken by the descending order of the points.

columns.name: num_accidents
columns.description: The number of accidents the driver has been involved in, replace NULL values with 0. Accident refers to status = "Accident".

columns.name: avg_pit_stop_duration
columns.description: The average duration (in milliseconds) of the pit stops the driver has made.
